newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore gets new mobile phone, Asia next.
newsitem.headline: Singapore gets new mobile phone, Asia next.

text.p: Hagenuk (Pte) Ltd said on Wednesday it had entered the Singapore market with the world's first GSM mobile phone with an internal antenna.
The company is a joint venture between Singapore's IPC Corp and Germany's Hagenuk Telecom GmbH.
Hagenuk president Benoit Mauffery, said the GlobalHandy phone had a "patch anntenna" completely embeded in the casing.
"Following the Singapore launch, plans are in the pipeline to introduce the product in the other Asia-Pacific markets," Hagenuk said in a statement.
Mauffery said the company expected its market share in Asia to reach more than 10 percent in the current year and that more than 300,000 phone units had been ordered.
IPC Corp holds a 43 percent stake in the joint venture.
